errors.API_KEY_MISSING: No API key yet. Add one in Settings.
errors.API_KEY_INVALID: The API key is invalid or lacks permission.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
errors.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: Today’s quota is used up. Come back tomorrow or use another key.
errors.TIMEOUT: No response for too long. Try again.
errors.CONTENT_BLOCKED: Blocked by safety filters. Try another image or description.
errors.NO_IMAGE: The model didn’t return an image this time. Try again.

errors.INVALID_RESPONSE: The AI returned something odd. Try again.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Invalid input (image too large or missing content).
errors.MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED: This model isn’t available on the shared quota. Use your own key.
errors.MODEL_NOT_FOUND: Model not found. It may have been retired.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: Image too large. Try a smaller one.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Gemini is overloaded. Try again later.
